instructions:
# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and
Haryana.
Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ, ਅਪਲੋਡ.
UI: ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਓ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ, ਅੱਗੇ, ਪਿੱਛੇ, ਖੋਜੋ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਮਦਦ.
Offices: ਤਹਿਸੀਲਦਾਰ, ਪਟਵਾਰੀ, ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ, ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਪੰਚਾਇਤ, ਡਿਪਟੀ ਕਮਿਸ਼ਨਰ.
Gender: ਲਿੰਗ. Money: ₹6,000; ₹8 ਲੱਖ. September: ਸਤੰਬਰ.

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,
ଡାଉନଲୋଡ, ଅପଲୋଡ.
UI: ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଦାଖଲ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ, ପଛକୁ, ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ସେୟାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ସେଟିଂସ୍, ଭାଷା, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ.
Offices: ତହସିଲଦାର, ବିଡିଓ, ଗ୍ରାମ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ, ଜିଲ୍ଲାପାଳ (କଲେକ୍ଟର), ମୋ ସେବା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର.
Gender: ଲିଙ୍ଗ. Money: ଟ.6,000; ଟ.8 ଲକ୍ଷ. September: ସେପ୍ଟେମ୍ବର.

items.t: How this member is related to the head named on the ration card.
West Tripura / 799001
Open the Ayushman beneficiary portal (or the Ayushman app) and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and the OTP.
Choose Tripura and the CM-JAY scheme, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending, verify with an Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, and take the live photo.
Fill in the relation to the head of the family, the district and the PIN code, and submit. The State Health Agency usually approves within a day or two.
Log in again and download the CM-JAY card. Do this for every member. If you get stuck, a CSC or the Ayushman desk at an empanelled hospital will make it for free.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman desk. Treatment is cashless up to Rs.5 lakh a year, so never pay cash for a covered treatment.
14555 — Ayushman Bharat / CM-JAY national helpline / 1800-345-3797 — State Health Agency Tripura toll-free
Ujjwala Free LPG Refill on Holi and Diwali (Muft Gas Cylinder)
Food & Civil Supplies Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, with Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum and HP Gas

Families in Uttar Pradesh with a PM Ujjwala gas connection get the money for two 14.2 kg refills a year back from the state government: one between October and December (Diwali) and one between January and March (Holi). You book and pay for the cylinder as usual, and the money comes back into your Aadhaar-linked bank account in about 3 to 4 days. There is no form. The only condition is that the connection holder's Aadhaar authentication is done at the gas agency. The UP cabinet approved the 2026–27 round on 9 October 2026.
Two 14.2 kg refills a year free, with the money credited back to your bank account
A PM Ujjwala (PMUY) gas connection in Uttar Pradesh
Aadhaar authentication (e-KYC) of the connection holder done at the gas agency
A bank account linked to Aadhaar, because the money goes only to the Aadhaar-linked account
One free refill in October–December and one in January–March. A refill outside these months is not refunded
The state approves the scheme again every year. The 2026–27 round runs from October 2026 to March 2027
Gas consumer number or the LPG passbook (blue book)
Bank passbook of the account linked to Aadhaar
Ration card, if the agency asks to check the family
Your LPG distributor (Indian Oil, Bharat Gas or HP Gas)

Nothing to fill in. The Ujjwala connection holder goes to her own LPG distributor (gas agency) in person with her Aadhaar card, the gas passbook or consumer number and the bank passbook, and gets the Aadhaar fingerprint authentication (e-KYC) done for free. Where the oil company's app offers it (IndianOil ONE, Hello BPCL, HP Pay), the e-KYC can also be done at home with Aadhaar face authentication.
LPG consumer number
Printed on the gas passbook and on every cash memo.
Connection type
PMUY (Ujjwala), 14.2 kg
The refund is only for Ujjwala connections. Ask the agency if you are not sure which type you have.
Name of connection holder
The woman in whose name the Ujjwala connection was given. She must go for the authentication herself.
The connection holder's own Aadhaar. Her fingerprint or face is matched against it.
Registered mobile
The number linked to the gas connection. The booking and delivery messages come here.
Aadhaar authentication
Done at gas agency (fingerprint)
It is done only once and is free. If it is pending, you will not get the refund.
Bank account linked to Aadhaar
99990087654321 / Bank of Baroda
Ask your bank to confirm this account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. The money goes only here.
Refill booked on
05-11-2026, by IVRS call
Book between October and December for the Diwali refill, and between January and March for the Holi refill.
Ask your gas agency whether your Aadhaar authentication is done. If not, the connection holder goes there with her Aadhaar card and gas passbook and gives her fingerprint. It is free.
Make sure your bank account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. Ask at your bank branch if you are not sure.
Between October and December, book a refill as usual (IVRS call, missed call, WhatsApp or the app). Pay the normal price at delivery and keep the cash memo.
In about 3 to 4 days the money is credited to your Aadhaar-linked bank account. Check the bank SMS or the passbook.
Between January and March, book one more refill the same way for the Holi refund.
If the money does not come, call the Ujjwala helpline 14438 or the UP food department toll-free number, with your consumer number and delivery date ready.
14438 (Ujjwala helpline) / 1906 (LPG emergency) / 1800-1800-150 (UP Food & Civil Supplies toll-free)
Krishi Yantra Anudan — Farm Machinery Subsidy (Yantra Token Booking)
Agriculture Department (Krishi Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh

The UP Agriculture Department pays 40–50% of the price of farm machines such as rotavators, seed drills, threshers, sprayers, super seeders, happy seeders and agricultural drones. Farmer groups setting up a farm machinery bank or custom hiring centre get up to 80%. Booking opens online on the Agri Darshan portal a few times a year: in 2026 it opened in February–March and again in July. Selected farmers get a token, buy the machine from a listed dealer, and upload the bill and a photo. After a check, the subsidy is paid into their bank account.
40–50% of the machine price for farmers; up to 80% for farmer groups and machinery banks
A farmer of Uttar Pradesh registered with the Agriculture Department, with the registration linked to Aadhaar, land record and bank account
Farm land in your own name, as shown in the Khatauni
Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher 50% share. Other farmers get 40%
A refundable security deposit is paid when booking: Rs.2,500 if the subsidy is Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, and Rs.5,000 if it is above Rs.1 lakh
One booking per mobile number in each window. Farmers are picked first-come-first-served, or by e-lottery when bookings exceed the district target
The machine must be bought within the days given on the token, or the token is cancelled
Farmer registration number from the Agriculture Department
Khatauni (land record)
Bank passbook of the Aadhaar-linked account in the farmer's name
Caste certificate, for SC or ST farmers
After buying: the dealer's GST bill and a photo of the farmer with the machine, showing its serial number
Agri Darshan — UP Agriculture Department portal
Registration No
Your farmer registration number with the Agriculture Department. If you do not have one, register first with Aadhaar, Khatauni and bank details.
The OTP comes here. Only one booking is allowed per mobile number, but you may use the number of a parent, brother, sister, son or daughter.
Meerut / Sardhana
Where your land is. Targets are fixed district by district.
Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
Choose the crop residue scheme (CRM) for super seeders, happy seeders, mulchers and balers.
Machine
Rotavator, 6 feet
Choose the exact machine and size. The subsidy amount for it is shown on the screen.
Farmer category
Small farmer, General
Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher share. It must match your land record and certificates.
Subsidy amount
Rs.35,000 (as shown on portal)
The fixed subsidy for that machine. You pay the full price to the dealer and this amount comes back to you.
Security amount
Rs.2,500, paid online
Rs.2,500 for a subsidy of Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, Rs.5,000 above that. It is refunded as the rules say.
Dealer
Kisan Agro Works, Sardhana
Buy only from a dealer listed on the portal for that machine, or the subsidy is not paid.
If you are not yet registered, register as a farmer on agridarshan.up.gov.in with Aadhaar, Khatauni and bank details, and note your registration number.

When booking opens (watch the news or ask the block agriculture office), open the portal, go to Kisan Corner, choose Yantra Booking, log in with the registration number and OTP, pick the scheme and machine, and pay the security amount.
Your token is confirmed by SMS, either straight away (first-come-first-served) or after the district e-lottery.
Within the days given on the token, buy the machine from a listed dealer at full price and take a GST bill.
Upload the bill and a photo of yourself with the machine on the portal. The block or district team checks the machine in person.
After the check, the subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT, and the security amount is refunded as the scheme rules say.
1800-180-1551 (Kisan Call Centre) / 1076 (CM Helpline); Deputy Director Agriculture office in your district
UP BOCW Shramik Panjikaran (Construction Worker Labour Card)
Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UPBOCW), Labour Department

Registering with the UP construction workers' board gives a construction worker a labour card. The card opens the family's main benefits: Rs.65,000 for a daughter's marriage, money at childbirth, school and college help for two children, a Rs.1,000 monthly pension after 60, and up to Rs.5 lakh if the worker dies in an accident. Masons, helpers, carpenters, bar benders, plumbers, electricians, painters, tile workers and road and building labourers can all register. You register online with Aadhaar e-KYC (or at a CSC) and renew the card to keep the benefits.
Rs.65,000 for a daughter's marriage, Rs.20,000–25,000 at childbirth, Rs.1,000 monthly pension, Rs.5 lakh on accidental death
Has done at least 90 days of building or other construction work in the last 12 months
Works in Uttar Pradesh and is not registered with the construction board of another state
Pays a Rs.20 registration fee once, plus Rs.20 for each year of membership chosen (1, 2 or 3 years). One year costs Rs.40 in all
Most benefits (marriage, maternity, serious illness) start after 1 year of membership. The pension needs 10 years of membership and age 60
Benefits go to at most two children, and you must apply within 1 year of the event
Aadhaar card, with OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile for e-KYC
Certificate of 90 days of work from the contractor or employer, or the board's self-declaration form
Family ID or ration card, to add family members
Bank passbook of an account in the worker's own name
Recent colour photo
UPBOCW labour portal
The worker's own Aadhaar. Your name, date of birth and address are filled in from Aadhaar after the OTP.
Enter 6-digit OTP
OTP from Aadhaar-linked mobile
The OTP goes to the mobile linked with Aadhaar. If that number is lost, get it updated at an Aadhaar centre first.
Your Aadhaar-linked number or any other number you keep. The approval SMS and login messages come here.
Family ID / Ration Card Number
Pick Family ID or Ration Card, enter the number, and the family members appear. Tick each member who should be linked to your card.
Mohalla Rajapur, Ward 12, Prayagraj
Where you live and work now, if it is different from the address on Aadhaar.
Nature of Work
Mason (Raj Mistri)
The construction work you actually do, for example helper, carpenter, plumber, painter or bar bender.
Worked Days (last 12 months)
It must be 90 days or more. The work certificate you upload has to show the same number.
Contractor Name / Contractor Mobile No.
Shiv Builders / 90000 12345
The contractor or employer who gave you the 90-day certificate. The office may call this number.
IFSC / Account Number
Your own account. Benefit money is paid only by DBT into this account.
Registration period
1 year: Rs.20 + Rs.20 = Rs.40
Choose 1, 2 or 3 years. Each year costs Rs.20 more. The Rs.20 registration fee is paid only once.
Open labour.upbocw.in and tap Register. Enter your Aadhaar number, tick the consent and verify with the OTP. Your details come from Aadhaar. Then enter a mobile number and set a password.
Log in and complete each part of the profile: personal details, family ID or ration card members, present address, work details and bank details.
Upload your photo and the 90-day work certificate, then tick the self-declaration.
Choose 1, 2 or 3 years and pay the fee online. Save the application number and the payment receipt.
The Labour Enforcement Officer at the district labour office checks the application. You get an SMS when it is approved.
Log in and download your labour card. Renew it up to one month before it expires, because benefits stop on an expired card.
After one year of membership, apply for benefits (daughter's marriage, maternity, children's education) from the same login or at a CSC, within 1 year of the event.
1800-180-5412 (UPBOCW toll-free); district Labour Office (Shram Karyalaya)
Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan (MMJAA Ayushman Card)
State Agency for Comprehensive Health and Integrated Services (SACHIS), Medical Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

Uttar Pradesh's own health cover for poor families who were left out of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. It gives the same Rs.5 lakh a year of free, cashless hospital treatment for the whole family at empanelled government and private hospitals, fully paid by the state. Covered families get the same Ayushman card, made free on the Ayushman portal or app, at a CSC, or at the Ayushman Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital. It has run since 1 March 2019 and is managed by SACHIS.
Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, same as the Ayushman card
Poor families who should have been covered by PM-JAY but were missed in the SECC 2011 list, and were later found in the state's own surveys
All Antyodaya (AAY) ration card families of Uttar Pradesh, added in July 2021
Construction workers registered with the UP BOCW board, and other groups the state government notifies
There is no limit on family size or age. Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
You cannot sign up on your own: the family's name must already be in the list. Check with Am I Eligible on the Ayushman portal or call 1800-1800-4444
Everyone aged 70 and above, whatever the income, gets the separate Ayushman Vay Vandana card
Aadhaar card of the member whose card is being made
Ration card (Antyodaya) or UP Family ID, to find the family in the list
Labour card, if the family is covered as a registered construction worker
Any working number you keep. The login OTP and the approval message come here.
Choose the state Uttar Pradesh. State scheme families are searched from the same Ayushman list. If MMJAA appears in the scheme list for UP, choose that.
Antyodaya families can search by ration card number. Others can search by Aadhaar, Family ID or name.
Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with the Aadhaar number of the head of the family.
The Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.
Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar. Otherwise choose face authentication on the phone camera.
Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets rejected.
Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown.
Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in, log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, choose Uttar Pradesh, and search for your family by ration card, Aadhaar or Family ID.
If your family's names appear, you are covered, whether under PM-JAY or the state's MMJAA. The card and the hospital benefit are the same.
Tap the Aadhaar icon next to a member marked eKYC pending, verify with an Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo and fill in the relation, district and PIN code.
Submit. SACHIS usually approves it within a day or two. Then open Download Card, verify with OTP and save the card on your phone.
If your family is not found, ask at the Ayushman Mitra desk of the nearest government hospital or at a CSC, or call 1800-1800-4444. A family that is not in the list cannot be added online.
1800-1800-4444 (SACHIS, Uttar Pradesh toll-free) / 14555 (national Ayushman helpline)
Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Kanya Sumangala)
Directorate of Women Welfare, Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh

Rs.25,000 for a daughter, paid in six parts from her birth until she joins college, straight into the mother's bank account (the father's or guardian's if the mother is not alive). The family applies online at each stage: birth, full vaccination, and admission to Class 1, Class 6, Class 9 and a degree or diploma. The total was raised from Rs.15,000 to Rs.25,000 from 1 April 2024.
The family lives permanently in Uttar Pradesh and has proof of residence
Family income is up to Rs.3 lakh a year
Up to two daughters of one family can get it. If the second delivery gives twin girls, all three girls are covered. Legally adopted daughters count within the two
Stage 1 (Rs.5,000) is for a girl born on or after 1 April 2019. Stage 2 (Rs.2,000) is for full vaccination, for a girl born on or after 1 April 2018

Stages 3 to 5 (Rs.3,000, Rs.3,000, Rs.5,000) are for admission to Class 1, Class 6 and Class 9 in the current school year. Stage 6 (Rs.7,000) is for admission to a degree or a diploma of at least 2 years after passing Class 10 or 12
Aadhaar of the applicant, father and mother is compulsory. The girl's own Aadhaar is needed from Stage 3 onward
Aadhaar card of the applicant, father and mother (and the girl from Stage 3 onward)
Proof of permanent residence in Uttar Pradesh
